headline: Qatar Is Working With Its Regional Partners And China To Resume Talks Between Us And Iran - Foreign Ministry Says
summary: Qatar says it is working with regional partners and China to resume talks between the United States and Iran. This is a fresh de-escalation signal, but not yet evidence of agreed negotiations or a ceasefire.

US2Y.note: No reliable intraday quote was available in this run; retained only as a clearly stale reference, not as a live directional trigger.
